<a2ui>
hdr = page_header(title="The Water Cycle", subtitle="Explore how Earth continuously recycles its water supply through evaporation, condensation, and precipitation.")
h1 = heading(text="Evaporation")
b1 = body(text="Heat from the sun warms water in oceans, lakes, and rivers, causing it to turn into invisible water vapor and rise into the atmosphere.")
h2 = heading(text="Condensation")
b2 = body(text="As water vapor rises, it cools and changes back into tiny liquid water droplets, gathering together to form clouds high in the sky.")
h3 = heading(text="Precipitation")
b3 = body(text="When the water droplets in clouds become too heavy, gravity pulls them back down to Earth as rain, snow, sleet, or hail.")
h4 = heading(text="Worked Example & Quiz")
b4 = body(text="Example: A puddle disappears on a sunny day due to evaporation. Quiz: 1. What turns liquid water into vapor? 2. How do clouds form? 3. What is rain considered?")
root = columns(cols=1, gap="1.5rem", align="top", items=[{blocks: [hdr, h1, b1, h2, b2, h3, b3, h4, b4]}])
</a2ui>
